questions.question_text: A quadrilateral has rotational symmetry of order two, two lines of symmetry and its angles are not right angles. What is the special name of this quadrilateral?
Work out the exact value of \sqrt{2\frac{7}{9}}.
Write down the next term for the sequence: 27, 19, 11, 3.
Find an expression, in terms of n, for the nth term of the sequence: 27, 19, 11, 3.
Work out (64)^{-\frac{2}{3}}.
v = u + at. Find v when u = 5, a = -3 and t = 4.
The four vertices of the rectangle each lie on the circle. The rectangle has dimensions 8 cm by 6 cm. Find the shaded area. Give your answer, in terms of \pi, in its simplest form.
5 numbers have a mean of 12. When a 6th number is included the mean is 9. Work out the 6th number.
Written as the product of its prime factors, 540 = 2^2 \times 3^3 \times 5. Write 360 as a product of its prime factors.
Find the highest common factor (HCF) of 540 and 360.
540n is a cube number. Find the smallest possible value of n.
Pierre records the colour of each of 200 cars passing his home (Silver: 23, Black: 68, Red: 35, Green: 20, Blue: 32, Other: 22). Write down the relative frequency of a silver car.
Explain why it is reasonable to use the answer to part (a) as the probability that the next car which passes will be silver.
Over the whole day 1200 vehicles pass Pierre's home. Estimate the number of these cars that are silver.
Factorise x^2 - x - 6.
Factorise 3ax + 2bx - 4by - 6ay.
In each Venn diagram, shade the given set: A \cup B and (A \cap B)'.
In this Venn diagram, the number of elements in each of the subsets is shown. Find n(P \cup (Q \cap R)).
In this Venn diagram, the number of elements in each of the subsets is shown. Find n((P \cup Q) \cap R').
The points A, B, C and D lie on a circle. PCQ is a tangent to the circle at C. Angle ABC = 110° and angle BAC = 30°. Find angle ADC.
The points A, B, C and D lie on a circle. PCQ is a tangent to the circle at C. Angle ABC = 110° and angle BAC = 30°. Find angle ACP.
The points A, B, C and D lie on a circle. PCQ is a tangent to the circle at C. Angle ABC = 110° and angle BAC = 30°. Find angle PCB.
Find \log_3(\frac{1}{9}).
Solve \log x + 2 \log 5 = \log 15.

A rectangular piece of paper has sides of length a cm and b cm. The paper is cut in half. The ratio of the length of the longer side to the length of the shorter side in both pieces of paper is the same. Find a in terms of b.
